hook.en: Every month, hormones prepare the uterus for a possible pregnancy, and if none happens, the lining is shed and the cycle starts again.
hook.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳು ಗರ್ಭಾಶಯವನ್ನು ಸಂಭಾವ್ಯ ಗರ್ಭಧಾರಣೆಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಒಳಪದರ ಕಳಚಿ ಚಕ್ರ ಮತ್ತೆ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The first menstruation at puberty is menarche. A cycle lasts on average 28/29 days. The menstrual phase (3–5 days) is the breakdown of the endometrium when the ovum is not fertilised. In the follicular (proliferative) phase, primary follicles grow into a Graafian follicle and the endometrium regenerates, under rising FSH, LH and estrogen. Both LH and FSH peak in the middle of the cycle, about day 14; this LH surge causes the Graafian follicle to rupture: ovulation. In the luteal (secretory) phase the corpus luteum secretes large amounts of progesterone, which maintains the endometrium.
body.kn: ಮೊದಲ ಋತುಸ್ರಾವ ರಜೋದರ್ಶನ. ಚಕ್ರ ಸರಾಸರಿ 28/29 ದಿನಗಳು. ಋತುಸ್ರಾವ ಹಂತ, ಕೋಶಕ ಹಂತ, ಅಂಡೋತ್ಸರ್ಗ (ಸುಮಾರು 14ನೇ ದಿನ LH ಏರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ) ಮತ್ತು ಲ್ಯೂಟಿಯಲ್ ಹಂತ ಇವೆ. ಕಾರ್ಪಸ್ ಲ್ಯೂಟಿಯಮ್ ಪ್ರೊಜೆಸ್ಟರೋನ್ ಸ್ರವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Follicular phase: Graafian follicle, estrogen rises

title.en: Board: hormones of the menstrual cycle

say.en: Here is a 28-day cycle. Estrogen rises as the follicle grows, and LH shoots up in a surge around day 14.
After ovulation the corpus luteum makes progesterone, which keeps the endometrium ready for implantation.
The phases: menstrual, days 1 to 5; follicular, up to ovulation; ovulation about day 14; luteal, from ovulation to day 28.
The LH surge ruptures the Graafian follicle. If there is no fertilisation, the corpus luteum degenerates, progesterone falls and menstruation begins.

body.en: If fertilisation does not occur, the corpus luteum degenerates, progesterone falls, and the endometrium breaks down: menstruation follows. In pregnancy the cycle stops because the corpus luteum is maintained. The cycle stops at menopause, around 50 years of age. Cycles may also stop because of stress or poor health.
body.kn: ನಿಷೇಚನ ಆಗದಿದ್ದರೆ ಕಾರ್ಪಸ್ ಲ್ಯೂಟಿಯಮ್ ನಶಿಸಿ ಋತುಸ್ರಾವ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಗರ್ಭಧಾರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಕ್ರ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ಸುಮಾರು 50 ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಋತುಬಂಧ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: No fertilisation → corpus luteum degenerates → menstruation

problem.en: A woman has a regular 28-day cycle and her period began on 1 March. On about which day is she likely to ovulate, and which hormone triggers it?

steps.en: In a 28-day cycle, ovulation occurs around the middle, day 14.
Counting day 1 as 1 March, day 14 is 14 March.
The mid-cycle surge of LH causes the Graafian follicle to rupture.

answer.en: About 14 March, triggered by the LH surge

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A woman has a regular 28-day cycle and her period began on 1 March. On about which day is she likely to ovulate, and which hormone triggers it?

body.en: Before ovulation the follicle is in charge and makes Estrogen; after ovulation the corpus luteum takes over and makes Progesterone. LH is the trigger in the middle.
